Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were
involved in in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle you were operating at the time?
A: Yes, I was driving.
Q: Can you walk me through what happened?
A: I was heading down the main road, moving slow because of traffic. The other car came over into my lane. We hit
head on, but it wasn't a hard hit. Both cars were going slow.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I always do.
Q: Did the airbags deploy in your vehicle?
A: No, they didn't go off. My car just stopped pretty fast and I jerked forward and back.
Q: Did you get checked out by anyone after the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day. My neck and lower back were sore right away, and the doctor said it
looked like a strain.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes. My neck is stiff when I turn my head, and my lower back hurts when I sit too long. I've been doing some
stretching and taking it easy at work.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?
A: No, nothing serious. I had a little stiffness now and then, but nothing that stopped me from working.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know aobut the collision?
A: I don't think so. I just want to get my car fixed and get back to normal.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
